correctness.rationale: Restriction of Klein quartic X^3Y+Y^3Z+Z^3X=0 to Z=-aX-bY has listed quartic coefficients. Square-of-quadratic criterion for leading coefficient nonzero produces two polynomial equations. Independently recomputed lex Gröbner basis over F5 exactly (b-a^26, P(a)) with P=a^28-a^21+2a^14+2a^7+1, checked derivative gcd 1 and irreducible factor degree list [1,3,6,6,6,6]. P(0)=1 validates nonzero leading term for all solutions. Odd-characteristic smooth genus-three quartic has exactly 28 geometric bitangents, so computed 28 exhaust all dual lines including chart c=0. Frobenius factor degrees give one rational line X+Y+Z=0, extension counts and zeta factor (1-T)^-1(1-T^3)^-1(1-T^6)^-4. The direct rational restriction equals negative square (X^2+XY+Y^2)^2. Checked original verify.py exact Gröbner/equation/irreducibility code; no reliance only on saved VERIFY_OK.
